# Your first ticket

> Profile: **New here**. Already know the workflow? Read [how-to](../work/how-to.md) (Working here).

1. List what you can start: `frob ticket doable`. Good-first tickets come with start notes.
2. Read one: `frob ticket show ~HANDLE --format md`. The acceptance list is your definition of done.
3. Take it: `frob work ~HANDLE`. This prints a worktree; work only there and only inside the ticket's scope.
4. Check your work: `frob check --ticket ~HANDLE`.
5. Finish: `frob land`.

To understand the fields you meet on the way, read [reading a ticket](reading-a-ticket.md).
